author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
Huge thanks to our friends Mary & Rami, who helped us tremendously while traveling through Syria. If you'd like to support them, or if you're planning your own trip to Syria and need guidance, check out their website: syrianguides.com 

We’ve finally arrived in Damascus, the capital of Syria and the oldest continuously inhabited city in the world. Walking through its streets feels like stepping back in time, history comes alive at every corner.
In the old town, the Jewish, Christian, and Muslim quarters sit side by side, with a mosque next to a church next to a synagogue, showcasing the city’s incredible diversity. Exploring the narrow alleys, we discovered some of Damascus’s oldest handicrafts and even had the chance to visit an authentic Damascene house.
Eventually, it was time to say goodbye to Syria. We took a fascinating flight with Syrian Airlines from Damascus to Istanbul, closing an unforgettable chapter of our journey 🎬
